messages:
mira: FYI ran the new reranker (rk-lite-v2 -> int8) bring-up smoke. NDCG@10 looks fine overall but MRR@10 drops ~6% on short queries (<=3 tokens).
jon: Ugh. Is that across all datasets or just prod holdout?
sasha: Any diffs in tokenization or candidate ordering between int8 and fp16 runs? Those usually bite short queries.
mira: Mostly on prod_holdout_short and a synthetic short-query slice. Full prod_holdout (mixed lengths) shows <1% ndcg delta and ~1% mrr delta.
jon: Can you paste the eval command you used?
mira: Sure:
```
./eval_harness \
  --model rk-lite-v2-int8 \
  --dataset datasets/prod_holdout_short.jsonl \
  --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 \
  --preproc strip_html=true,collapse_ws=true,lowercase=false \
  --batch-size 64 \
  --seed 42
```
arcady: Two quick things: 1) did you run with the same candidate ordering (stable sort) and dedupe flags, 2) any truncation differences?
mira: Candidates same order, dedupe on. Truncation window is identical. I attached a tiny reproducible sample in the ticket.
sasha: Can you run a tiny diff: fp16 vs int8 on the same 200 short queries and dump top-5 scores + tokenization for the queries that flip top result?
mira: On it. Quick peek shows many flips where the top doc has minimal context (title-only) and the model's margin is <0.02.
jon: That margin smells like quant noise. Also check if any normalization (strip punctuation) was accidentally toggled in the int8 pipeline.
mira: I grepped the preprocess config; strip_punct was false in both. However int8 path used our fast tokenizer binary (tok-fast) while fp16 harness used python tokenizers.
arcady: there you go. tok-fast differs on leading/trailing punctuation (e.g., "C++" -> ["C","++"]). For short queries that's huge.
sasha: Two proposed repro steps: 1) re-run int8 eval swapping in python tokenizers to isolate tokenizer difference, 2) run fp16 with tok-fast to see symmetric effect.
mira: Running step 1 now. ETA ~30m. Will post raw diff of swapped examples.
dev-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed rk-lite-v2-int8 to staging (sha: abc123).
jon: Also open a small experiment: quant noise mitigation by score smoothing / temperature clip. If tokenizer swap doesn't explain it we try that.
arcady: For metrics, please include per-query length buckets (1,2,3,4-8,9+). Add bootstrapped CI for MRR to confirm significance.
mira: adding buckets + bootstraps. If tokenizer swap explains >80% of drop we treat as infra mismatch; otherwise we'll try score-smoothing.
sasha: If it's infra, we should update bring-up checklist: force same tokenizer binary and a quick short-query smoke before canary.
jon: Agreed. Also add a small Canary: 5% shadow traffic for 24h, compare online CTR/engagement and log any top-1 flips.
mira: Filing tickets: RK-8721 (repro + tokenizer swap), RK-8722 (quant-mitigation experiments), RK-8723 (onboard checklist update). I'll attach samples/results.
arcady: Thanks. Ping here when you have the swapped diffs.
mira: Will do :thumbsup:
